an5.180:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
an5.180:1.2: addasā kho bhagavā addhānamaggapaṭipanno aññatarasmiṃ padese mahantaṃ sālavanaṃ.
an5.180:1.3: disvā maggā okkamma yena taṃ sālavanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ sālavanaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātvākāsi.
an5.180:2.2: “ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
an5.180:2.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an5.180:2.5: “ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?
an5.180:3.1: bhūtapubbaṃ ānanda, imasmiṃ padese nagaraṃ ahosi iddhañceva phītañca bahujanaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ.
an5.180:3.2: taṃ kho pana ānanda, nagaraṃ kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho upanissāya vihāsi.
an5.180:3.3: kassapassa kho pana ānanda, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa gavesī nāma upāsako ahosi sīlesu aparipūrakārī.
an5.180:3.4: gavesinā kho ānanda, upāsakena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭidesitāni samādapitāni ahesuṃ sīlesu aparipūrakārino.
an5.180:3.5: atha kho ānanda gavesissa upāsakassa etadahosi:
an5.180:3.6: “ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā. ahañcamhi sīlesu aparipūrakārī. imāni ca pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu aparipūrakārino.
an5.180:4.1: atha kho ānanda, gavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etadavoca:
an5.180:4.3: atha kho ānanda, tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi:
an5.180:4.4: “ayyo kho gavesī amhākaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā,
an5.180:4.5: ayyo hi nāma gavesī sīlesu paripūrakārī bhavissati.
an5.180:4.7: atha kho ānanda, tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena gavesī upāsako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā gavesiṃ upāsakaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an5.180:4.8: “ajjatagge ayyo gavesī, imāni pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino dhāretū”ti.
an5.180:4.9: atha kho ānanda, gavesissa upāsakassa etadahosi:
an5.180:4.10: “ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā. ahañcamhi sīlesu paripūrakārī. imāni ca pañcaupāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino.
an5.180:5.1: atha kho ānanda, gavesī upāsako yena tāni pañcaupāsakasatāni tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etadavoca:
an5.180:5.2: “ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto brahmacāriṃ dhāretha ārācāriṃ virataṃ methunā gāmadhammā”ti. (2)
an5.180:5.3: atha kho ānanda, tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi:
an5.180:5.4: “ayyo kho gavesī amhākaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā.
an5.180:5.5: ayyo hi nāma gavesī brahmacāri bhavissati. ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
an5.180:5.7: atha kho ānanda, tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena gavesī upāsako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā gavesiṃ upāsakaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an5.180:5.8: “ajjatagge ayyo gavesī imāni pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino dhāretu ārācārino viratā methunā gāmadhammā”ti.
an5.180:5.9: atha kho ānanda, gavesissa upāsakassa etadahosi:
an5.180:5.10: “ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā.
an5.180:5.12: imāni ca pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino.
an5.180:5.13: ahañcamhi brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāma dhammā.
an5.180:5.14: imāni ca pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino ārācārino viratā methunā gāmadhammā.
an5.180:6.1: atha kho ānanda, gavesī upāsako yena tāni pañca upāsakasatāni tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā tāni pañca upāsakasatāni etadavoca:
an5.180:6.2: “ajjatagge maṃ āyasmanto ekabhattikaṃ dhāretha rattūparataṃ virataṃ vikālabhojanā’ti. (3)
an5.180:6.3: atha kho ānanda, tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi:
an5.180:6.4: “ayyo kho gavesī amhākaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā.
an5.180:6.5: ayyo hi nāma gavesī ekabhattiko bhavissati rattuparato virato vikālabhojanā.
an5.180:6.7: atha kho ānanda, tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena gavesī upāsako tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā gavesiṃ upāsakaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an5.180:6.8: “ajjatagge ayyo gavesī imāni pañca upāsakasatāni ekabhattike dhāretu rattūparate virate vikālabhojanā”ti.
an5.180:6.9: atha kho ānanda, gavesissa upāsakassa etadahosi:
an5.180:6.10: “ahaṃ kho imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā.
an5.180:6.12: imāni ca pañca upāsakasatāni sīlesu paripūrakārino.
an5.180:6.13: ahañcamhi brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
an5.180:6.14: imāni ca pañca upāsakasatāni brahmacārino ārācārino viratā methunā gāmadhammā.
an5.180:6.16: imāni ca pañcaupāsakasatāni ekabhattikā rattuparatā viratā vikālabhojanā. (3)
an5.180:7.1: atha kho ānanda, gavesī upāsako yena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca:
an5.180:7.2: “labheyyāhaṃ bhante, bhagavato, santike pabbajjaṃ. labheyyaṃ upasampadaṃ”ti.
an5.180:7.3: alattha kho ānanda, gavesī upāsako kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ (4) alattha upasampadaṃ. (5)
an5.180:7.4: acirūpasampanno kho pana ānanda, gavesī bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
an5.180:7.5: “khīṇājāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti abbhaññāsi.
an5.180:7.6: aññataro ca pana ānanda, gavesī bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosi.
an5.180:8.1: atha kho ānanda, tesaṃ pañcannaṃ upāsakasatānaṃ etadahosi:
an5.180:8.2: “ayyo kho gavesī amhākaṃ bahukāro pubbaṅgamo samādapetā.
an5.180:8.3: ayyo hi nāma gavesī kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati.
an5.180:8.5: atha kho ānanda, tāni pañca upāsakasatāni yena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavocuṃ:
an5.180:8.6: “labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadaṃ”ti.
an5.180:8.7: alabhiṃsu kho ānanda, tāni pañca upāsakasatāni kassapassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ, alabhiṃsu upasampadaṃ.
an5.180:9.1: atha kho ānanda, gavesissa bhikkhuno etadahosi:
an5.180:9.2: “ahaṃ kho imassa anuttarassa vimuttisukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an5.180:9.3: aho vatimānipi pañca bhikkhusatāni imassa anuttarassa vimuttisukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino”ti.
an5.180:9.4: atha kho ānanda, tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni vūpakaṭṭhā appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharantā nacirasseva, yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ
an5.180:9.5: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihariṃsu.
an5.180:9.6: “khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā”ti abhaññiṃsu.
an5.180:10.1: iti kho ānanda, tāni pañca bhikkhusatāni gavesīpamukhāni uttaruttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ vāyamamānā anuttaraṃ vimuttisukhaṃsacchākaṃsu.
